title: WordPress builds place brief photos through the fill plan; the WordPress writer reaches position slots and the header and footer, which the sweep then leaves to the contract
steps: S1: Run node --test apps/tracy-web/test/brief-wp-fill-plan.test.mjs and apps/tracy-web/test/brief-wp-parts-in-map.test.mjs (a fictional tea room and racket club on WordPress-shaped v3 maps, plus the released ja-essence 1.0.12 map).
S2: Run node --test packages/cms/tracy-seeder/test/wordpress-block-address.test.mjs (capture and writer share one walker; position slots written and read back).
expect: S1: exit 0, no failed or skipped test; each WordPress card takes its own offering photo with the Joomla reason codes, a released map keeps the old planner, the sweep leaves a part the map covers untouched and sweeps the others.

S2: exit 0, no failed or skipped test; every captured slot reads back its sample, each position slot is written and reads back equal, a position past the last block is refused, the header part is written in one read and one write.
evidence: Before this change WordPress builds guessed picture roles from slot names, the seeder could not write a slot addressed by position, and the header and footer were outside every WordPress content map.
fence: shapeReal takes the fill plan for any v3 map with a brief; writeSlotValue locates a block by name or by blockType + occurrence through blockUnits, the walker the capture uses
